# Animated characters

Adapted from https://github.com/arsh342/careercompass at revision `fade6f4a83ebc8ca3790ae56d06f1fcd9a43b1f1`, `src/components/ui/animated-characters.tsx` (2026-10-23).

MIT license retained in LICENSE. Four original character silhouettes, colors, tracking and peeking behavior are reused. Local changes: scoped CSS equivalents for Tailwind utilities, password-focus privacy state, reduced-motion handling, and tracked timeout cleanup on unmount. No upstream authentication service or credential logging is used.
